🌐 GitHub Pages Deployment

Publish Your App Live (Free on GitHub Pages)

Earlier, your GitHub repository jeffgachago0-hash/Secret-santa-Project ran into a deployment issue because a template workflow was triggered with no jobs. Since this app is 100% static client-side HTML, CSS & JavaScript, making it live takes less than 2 minutes:

1

Replace/Commit index.html in the Root

Make sure the root directory of your repository contains this complete index.html file. You can download the complete standalone file directly using the button below.

2

Fix GitHub Pages Settings (The 1-Click Fix)

Go to your repository settings on GitHub:

  1. Go to Settings → Pages.
  2. Under Build and deployment > Source, select Deploy from a branch (instead of GitHub Actions).
  3. Under Branch, select main and folder /(root).
  4. Click Save.
3

Your Live URL

Within 30–60 seconds, GitHub Pages publishes your app automatically at:

https://jeffgachago0-hash.github.io/Secret-santa-Project/

📖 How the Secret Santa Matching Works

1. Mathematical Derangement

A derangement is a permutation where no element appears in its original position. That guarantees absolutely no one draws their own name.

2. Exclusion Constraints

You can forbid specific pairs (e.g., partners, siblings, or roommates). The backtracking solver tests combinations until a valid assignment is reached.

3. Zero-Server Privacy

Everything runs strictly in your browser. No emails or names are sent to any external server or tracking database.
